# mcp


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets an AI agent, such as Claude Code,
Codex, or Cursor, discover and call external tools. This module exposes
fossick functions as MCP tools. The agent sees each tool’s name,
arguments, and docstring. These docstrings tell the agent when to use
each option. They define the tool interface and are longer than other
fossick docstrings.

Most tools take the arguments of the Python function they wrap. They
also take a limit on returned text, such as `max_chars`. A tool cuts a
long result at that limit. It adds a note with the number of cut
characters. The note tells an agent to ask for more. Tools convert
results to plain JSON types before returning them. The server uses
standard input and output by default.

### research

``` python
def research(
    query:str, n:int=5, google:bool=False, region:str='auto', timelimit:str | None=None, sel:str | None=None,
    chars:int=4000
)->dict:
```

*Search and read the top n readable results in parallel. Escalate past
bot walls, skip bot-wall or empty pages, and backfill skipped results.
Return {query, sources, digest, dropped, region}. digest is cited
markdown with one \## section per source. Each section contains passages
that answer the query and the source publication date. region accepts a
DDGS country-lang code or auto. Set it when the answer depends on
jurisdiction or market. timelimit d|w|m|y keeps recent sources.*

## Hidden APIs

[`find_hidden_apis`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/mcp.html#find_hidden_apis)
and
[`capture_network`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/mcp.html#capture_network)
record and number a page’s background requests. The server keeps the
list from the most recent call.
[`replay_capture`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/mcp.html#replay_capture)
sends request `capture_id` from that list as a plain HTTP call with the
browser’s cookies.
[`paginate_api`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/cli.html#paginate_api)
reads every page of a JSON API. It returns at most `max_items` items.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/fossick/blob/main/fossick/cli.py#L224"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

## Browser and shop

[`browse`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/mcp.html#browse) opens
a page in debug Chrome and returns its snapshot. The server remembers
that page. The `page_*` tools act on it until the next
[`browse`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/mcp.html#browse). The
`shop_*` tools use one shopping session opened by
[`shop_open`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/mcp.html#shop_open).
They wrap `fossick.shop`.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/fossick/blob/main/fossick/mcp.py#L267"

## Connecting a client

``` sh
uvx fossick-mcp          # standard input and output
fossick-mcp --http       # Streamable HTTP
```

Configure your agent to run the first command as an MCP server. If your
project already depends on fossick, run `uv run fossick-mcp`. This uses
the project environment and installs no separate copy.

## Safety settings

A page that the agent reads can contain instructions for the agent. The
server is strict by default. Use these environment variables to change
its settings.

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 33%" />
<col style="width: 33%" />
<col style="width: 33%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Variable</th>
<th>Default</th>
<th>Effect</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>FOSSICK_MCP_SESSION=1</code></td>
<td>off</td>
<td>Turns on the tools that use the logged-in debug Chrome: <a
href="https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/mcp.html#browse"><code>browse</code></a>,
<code>page_*</code>, <a
href="https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/mcp.html#capture_network"><code>capture_network</code></a>,
<code>shop_*</code>, <code>session=</code>, <code>auto=</code> and the
cookies of <a
href="https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/mcp.html#replay_capture"><code>replay_capture</code></a>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>FOSSICK_MCP_PAY=1</code></td>
<td>off</td>
<td>Lets <code>shop_fill(confirm=True)</code> click a payment
button.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>FOSSICK_MCP_ROOT</code></td>
<td>working folder</td>
<td>The one folder that tools can read local files from and write files
to.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>FOSSICK_MCP_TOKEN</code></td>
<td>new each start</td>
<td>The bearer token for <code>--http</code>. With none set, the server
makes one and prints it to stderr.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

`--http` binds only to a loopback address. It refuses requests with an
incorrect `Host` or `Origin` header. Plain HTTP tools stop at
`MAX_BYTES` (20 MB) per page.
